cc:Work.dc:title: Tray - TypeTray
cc:Work.dc:description:
Type tray - allows only continuous walls
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes TypeTray --sx '50*3' --sy '50*2' --h 60 --hi 0 --outside 0 --bottom_edge h --top_edge e --fingerholes none --gripwidth 0 --gripheight 30 --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes TypeTray --sx --sy --h --outside --reference
